## Design

- [Google design](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/data-sources/google.md), section 3.
- [Open-Meteo design](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/data-sources/open-meteo.md).
- [Tool design](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/tools.md), section 2.5.

## Open questions

- ~~Is the first day of a Google Weather forecast today? Google design section 3 assumes so, but it isn't confirmed.~~ Settled 2026-10-21 in chat: not always. Before 7 a.m. local time, the first day is yesterday. The client asks for 10 days and picks each date by its `displayDate`. Written into Google design section 3.
- ~~Should the tool's name start with a verb, as the other tools' names do?~~ Settled 2026-10-21 in chat: yes, `look_up_stay_weather`. Not `get_stay_weather`, since next to `set_stay_weather` it would read as getting the saved text. Written into tool design 2.5 and section 3.

## Do

- Add the Google Weather client, the Open-Meteo client, and `look_up_stay_weather`, which picks the source from the stay's dates.

## Done when

- Tests use saved responses, including Open-Meteo's spent-limit reply.
- A real call for a stay within 7 days returns a forecast.
- A real call for a stay in October 2027 returns seasonal averages, labeled "Typical for this time of year, based on 2016–2025."
- A forecast that leaves out a date returns an error.

## Ends in

A PR.

**Settled in:** chat. Propose each answer to Joe in chat first, and write it in once he agrees.

---

Moved from the [development plan](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/plan/development-plan.md#phase-30-weather-data).
